question: From the north most to south most point of India, what is the extent of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3214 km**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indira Point is the southernmost point of India's Union.

 
 
• Indira point is also known as Pygmalion point.
 
• It got its name in 1985.
 
• It was renamed in honour of former Indian prime minister Indira Gandhi.
 
• Indira Point is located near Great Nicobar.
 
• It is located at 6°8′ N latitude.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• The north-south extent from Indira Col in Kashmir to Kanyakumari is 3,214 km.
 
• The east-west width from the Rann of Kutch to Arunachal Pradesh is 2,933 km.
 
• With an area of 32,87,263 sq km, India is the seventh-largest country in the world.
 
• India accounts for about 2.4 per cent of the total surface area of the world. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Extreme points of India:

 
 

 Easternmost
 Kibithu in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
 

 Westernmost
 Ghuar Mota in the Kutch region of Gujarat.
 
 

 Northernmost
 Indira Col
 
 

 Southernmost (Mainland)
 Kanyakumari is also known as Cape Comorin.
